messages.content: Picking an event schema migration back up.
OK, back on an event schema migration.

**Choice:** Flink for the stateful stream processing.
Retries only apply to failed jobs.
Between the options, consumer offsets committed after processing came out ahead.
Error — silent message loss from an auto-commit race.

Turned out scripts/replay.py was the culprit file. There's consumer lag growing unbounded during the nightly spike in production. Nothing failed on the last run. We landed on a separate cluster for the analytics workloads.

We landed on Debezium for change data capture. I'd go with one topic per event type rather than a shared bus. Managed to finish exactly-once semantics on the aggregation job. If the tests fail, the pipeline blocks the merge.

Still open: migrating the remaining consumers off the v1 schema. Turns out the flakiness was duplicate processing after an unclean rebalance. I've wrapped a schema registry entry for every event type.
Resolved: an integration test spinning up a real broker.
Partitioning by tenant rather than by hash is waiting on me. Nothing failed on the last run.
Still open: an automated schema compatibility check in CI. Path: schemas/order_placed.avsc. Let me check the docs first. Decision made: Kafka over Kinesis for the event backbone.
